name: Horizontal Project Kanban
notes: V15.2.18 rebuilds Project Agenda and Projects as horizontal drag-and-drop boards with protected starting and Completed columns, synchronized custom columns, full-card mouse, touch, and keyboard movement, completion confirmation, and five-second Undo. Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, project values, payments, revision history, calculations, balances, and the five-minute sync cadence are unchanged.
